correctness.rationale: Bell overlaps of the Gibbs state define a Pauli channel. Applying two independent copies to the source input gives C_out=max{C_in lambda_perp^2-(1-lambda_z^2)/2,0}, which simplifies to the package's prefactor-4 formula. Independent direct Hamiltonian diagonalization, Bell probabilities, two-copy channel application and Wootters concurrence agreed across both signs of J and several D,T,theta values. Expanding at large |D| gives C_in/(1+D^2)+O(exp(-|J|sqrt(1+D^2)/T)), proving eventual positivity. A bibliographic detail is wrong but non-mathematical: arXiv v1 labels the printed formula Eq. (8), not Eq. (14).
residual_risks: The repeated Eq. (14) citation should be editorially corrected to Eq. (8) for arXiv v1 before any public synchronization; the formula and theorem are unaffected.
